Saturn’s rings explained

The rings of Saturn are made mostly of water ice, with a smaller share of rock and dust spread through them.

Scientists still debate whether the rings are as old as the planet, or formed far more recently from a moon that broke apart.

Twenty extensions,
already here.

They ship inside Browsery, so nothing is downloaded from the web. Open the puzzle-piece button, pick one in the Store and press Add.

    Blocking happens on your computer.

    The Privacy shield stops ads and trackers locally and keeps a running count. If a site breaks, allow it with one click and restore protection whenever you like.

    • Ads and trackersBlocked at Standard, Balanced or Strict. Strict is the default.
    • Suspicious linksLinks that look like phishing, such as look-alike domains, are paused first. You can open anyway or go back. It is not antivirus.
    • HTTPS enforcementPlain http addresses are upgraded to https.
    • Private sessionsTabs use a temporary profile. History, closed tabs and the session are not saved.
    • Site permissionsCamera, microphone, location and notifications ask first, with Block or Allow.

    Before you download.

    Is Browsery free?

    Yes. It costs nothing. You sign in with a free Browsery account, made with your email and a password.

    Do I need a Groq API key?

    Only for the AI features: Hey Groq, Analyze with Groq and the AI Overview on search results. Everything else works without one. The setup after sign-in offers to add it, or add it later in Settings, AI Overview.

    Windows warned me about the installer.

    The installer is not code signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn you. Choose More info, then Run anyway. The release page lists a SHA-256 checksum if you want to check the file first.

    How do I install the Android app?

    Download the APK on your phone and open it. Android asks once to allow installs from your browser or Files app; turn that on and tap Install. If Play Protect warns you, choose More details, then Install anyway. It needs Android 7.0 or newer, and it also runs in BlueStacks. Browsery for Android has the Saturn new tab, tabs and private tabs, the privacy shield, Reader view, Night Shift and Hey Groq with your own Groq key.

    What does Groq see?

    Only what you send it. Hey Groq gets your question as text, never audio, plus a short summary of Browsery’s state such as a few settings and the current site’s name. Analyze with Groq sends a screenshot of the visible page, and only when you click it. The AI Overview sends your search.

    Where does my browsing data live?

    On your computer. The account is for signing in. History, bookmarks and blocking all stay local.

    How do updates work?

    Browsery checks quietly after it starts but never downloads by itself. Click Update in the toolbar when you are ready, then Restart.
